basic_info.description: Welcome to the Penthouse at Mission Crown! The crown jewel at this stunning collection of 11 extensively remodeled residences housed behind a restored historic Victorian facade. Residence 3441-P is an expansive flat with soaring ceilings, open kitchen and a private roof deck with 360 views. Four bedrooms and two and one half bathrooms provide ample flexibility of space. In-unit laundry is included. Enjoy all the charm and character of a classic San Francisco building, with modern features and updates ideal for today's living needs. The extensive building remodel includes new electrical, plumbing, seismic retrofitting and new foundations. Experience the vibrant Mission District with world-class dining, nightlife, and numerous shopping options right at your doorstep. Easily walkable to the Valencia corridor and the bustling 20th street restaurant scene. Nearby access to public transport makes exploring the city a breeze! Reach out today to schedule your private tour.
